label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The very first Tab stop was a Dismiss this popup button reported as inside an embedded payment field, which was confusing before any page content had been heard.
Several links in the hero area had no name or only the text Visit link, so I could not tell where they led and had to open one blind.

Reaching Add to Cart meant tabbing through a very long header, because the Shop All menu opens on focus with about ten extra stops, and I needed Shift+Tab detours plus the skip link to get to the button.
Pressing Add to Cart gave no confirmation, because the cart count stayed at 0 until a later re-read and focus stayed on the button, so I could not tell whether it worked.

The cart drawer is not a proper focus trap: Shift+Tab from Close dialog sent focus out of the drawer to the top of the page, and there are about nine tab stops of upsell items, one unnamed link and an unrelated View sample plans button before Check Out.
